children: The South Korean won and Taiwan dollar are expected to lead Asian currencies in 2027, supported by strong technology exports, ING says. Lower oil prices and a softer dollar should support regional currencies in the year, says chief economist Deepali Bhargava. ING prefers the won and Taiwan dollar, citing strong AI-related exports, large current-account surpluses and exporters converting foreign-currency earnings into local currencies. It forecasts the U.S. dollar at 1,275 won and at NT$31.5 by end-2027. ING expects another year of relative strength for the Singapore dollar, with the city-state expected to post 4.0% growth for 2027 as a neutral hub attracting U.S. and Chinese investment. It expects the U.S. dollar at S$1.26 by end-2027. (monica.gupta@wsj.com)
